About Avalia Adventure

A Local Team With
A Decade on the Ground

Avalia Adventure is a ground tour operator based in Arusha, Tanzania, organising wildlife safaris, mountain trekking, and cultural tours across the country. We are not a booking website — we are the people in the vehicle, on the trail, and at the campfire with you.

For more than 10 years our guides have driven guests through the northern circuit's most iconic parks, coordinating everything from no-frills camping trips to fully luxury lodge experiences, always built around what each traveller actually wants.

"When the wild calls your name, you don't plan a trip — you answer it."

What We Do

Current Activities & Services

01

Guiding National Park Tours

We drive guests through the northern circuit's most iconic parks — Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, Tarangire, and Lake Manyara — for unforgettable game viewing.

02

Hosting Every Travel Style

From no-frills camping safaris to mid-range comfort tours and fully luxury lodge trips, we coordinate the experience that fits your budget and your dream.

03

Mountain Trekking & Culture

Beyond game drives, we organise Kilimanjaro and Meru climbs, plus cultural village visits that connect you with Tanzania's people, not just its wildlife.
